name: Legal Live Transfers

hero.headline: Legal Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for legal solutions.

overview: Legal Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Deliver case inquiries and calls from individuals seeking legal representation in personal injury, mass tort, family law and other practice areas.

Live Transfers bring intake discipline to legal acquisition. Our team confirms the practice area, the nature and date of the incident or diagnosis, jurisdiction, representation status and consent before warm-transferring the individual to the law firm's intake team. For mass tort campaigns, screening applies the specific exposure, usage and diagnosis criteria the litigation requires, so firms receive claimants who fit the case profile. This pre-screen removes time-barred matters, represented parties and out-of-jurisdiction inquiries, and it complements web leads by converting form submissions and online researchers into live intake conversations with higher signed-retainer rates.

This product is suited to web leads businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of legal consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Adults who have recently experienced a qualifying event, such as an accident with injuries, exposure to a product subject to litigation, a marital breakdown or a workplace issue, and who have not yet retained counsel. The most valuable segments are injured parties with clear liability and medical treatment, mass tort claimants who meet specific exposure and diagnosis criteria, and family law clients with contested matters.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for a personal injury lawyer, car accident attorney or divorce lawyer near me; recently injured in a motor vehicle, workplace or premises accident; diagnosed with a condition linked to a drug, device or product under active litigation; received a settlement offer from an insurance company and wants it reviewed.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "personal injury lawyer near me" and "car accident attorney", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard legal criteria include: practice area and nature of the legal issue identified; incident or diagnosis date within the applicable statute of limitations; located in a jurisdiction where the firm or its network is licensed to practise; not currently represented by another attorney for the same matter; practice-area-specific criteria met, such as injuries with medical treatment or a qualifying diagnosis for mass tort; consent to be contacted captured and interest in a case evaluation confirmed.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.q: Which practice areas can be targeted?
faq.a: Programs can be built for personal injury, motor vehicle accidents, mass tort and product liability, family law, employment, Social Security disability, immigration and other consumer practice areas, individually or in combination.

faq.q: How are mass tort claimants qualified?
faq.a: Screening applies the litigation-specific criteria you provide, such as product usage period, diagnosis type and date, so that transferred claimants match the case profile before your intake team engages.

faq.q: How do calls complement legal web leads?
faq.a: Web leads deliver case inquiry volume at scale, while Inbound Calls and Live Transfers route individuals who need to speak immediately to your intake team, improving contact rates and signed retainers.
